newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian customs seize 44.5 kg of heroin.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian customs seize 44.5 kg of heroin.

text.p: Bulgarian customs officers said on Friday they had seized 44.5 kg (98 lbs) of heroin smuggled on board a Turkish-registered tourist bus from Turkey.

The heroin was discovered at the Kapitan Andreevo checkpoint at routine customs checks in a Mercedes vehicle owned by a Turkish firm Marcel Ali Baba Tours, customs' directorate spokesman Ivan Kutevski told Reuters.
The two Turkish drivers were detained.
The heroin, distributed in 89 packages, was concealed in the air-conditioning system of the bus, which was coming from Istanbul and was bound for Bucharest.
Customs did not give a figure for the value of the haul.
Bulgaria, which lies on the so-called "Balkan route" from the Middle East to western Europe, has stopped 14.4 tonnes (31,752 lb) of drugs in 1996 including 195.5 kg (431 lb) of heroin.
